name: 7.css
description: A design system for building faithful recreations of the Windows 7 UI.

distribution.integrity_verified: The sha512 of the downloaded tarball matched the npm registry dist.integrity value.

modifications: None. Files are unmodified copies from package/dist (7.css, 7.css.map) and the package root (LICENSE, README.md). Project-specific styling lives in assets/css/aero.css, which only overrides 7.css through the cascade.
used_build: dist/7.css (global build; it only sets :root variables plus rules for a, button, details, fieldset, input, label, menu, select, table, textarea and ul, and the component classes). Icons are embedded as data: URIs, so no runtime request is made to any CDN.
